versos.grego: Ἔλεγεν δὲ καὶ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητάς Ἄνθρωπός τις ἦν πλούσιος ὃς εἶχεν οἰκονόμον, καὶ οὗτος διεβλήθη αὐτῷ ὡς διασκορπίζων τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
controles.kjv: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
controles.livre: E dizia também a seus discípulos: Havia um certo homem rico, o qual tinha um mordomo; e este lhe foi acusado de fazer perder seus bens.

versos.grego: καὶ φωνήσας αὐτὸν εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τί τοῦτο ἀκούω περὶ σοῦ; ἀπόδος τὸν λόγον τῆς οἰκονομίας σου· οὐ γὰρ δύνῃ ἔτι οἰκονομεῖν.

controles.web: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
controles.kjv: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
controles.livre: E ele, chamando-o, disse-lhe: Como ouço isto sobre ti? Presta contas de teu trabalho, porque não poderás mais ser meu mordomo.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ ἐν ἑαυτῷ ὁ οἰκονόμος Τί ποιήσω, ὅτι ὁ κύριός μου ἀφαιρεῖται τὴν οἰκονομίαν ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ; σκάπτειν οὐκ ἰσχύω, ἐπαιτεῖν αἰσχύνομαι.

controles.web: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.
controles.kjv: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
controles.livre: E disse o mordomo para si mesmo: O que farei, agora que meu senhor está me tirando o trabalho de mordomo? Cavar eu não posso; mendigar eu tenho vergonha.

versos.grego: ἔγνων τί ποιήσω, ἵνα ὅταν μετασταθῶ ἐκ τῆς οἰκονομίας δέξωνταί με εἰς τοὺς οἴκους ἑαυτῶν.

controles.web: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’
controles.kjv: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
controles.livre: Eu sei o que farei, para que, quando eu for expulso do meu trabalho de mordomo, me recebam em suas casas.

versos.grego: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος ἕνα ἕκαστον τῶν χρεοφειλετῶν τοῦ κυρίου ἑαυτοῦ ἔλεγεν τῷ πρώτῳ Πόσον ὀφείλεις τῷ κυρίῳ μου;

controles.web: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’
controles.kjv: So he called every one of his lord’s debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
controles.livre: E chamando a si a cada um dos devedores de seu senhor, disse ao primeiro: Quanto deves a meu senhor?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ἑκατὸν βάτους ἐλαίου. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Δέξαι σου τὰ γράμματα καὶ καθίσας ταχέως γράψον πεντήκοντα.

controles.web: He said, ‘A hundred batosof oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
controles.kjv: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
controles.livre: E ele disse: Cem medidas de azeite. E disse-lhe: Pega a tua conta, senta, e escreve logo cinquenta.

versos.grego: ἔπειτα ἑτέρῳ εἶπεν Σὺ δὲ πόσον ὀφείλεις; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ἑκατὸν κόρους σίτου. λέγει αὐτῷ Δέξαι σου τὰ γράμματα καὶ γράψον ὀγδοήκοντα.

controles.web: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred corsof wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
controles.kjv: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
controles.livre: Depois disse a outro: E tu, quanto deves? E ele disse: Cem volumes de trigo. E disse-lhe: Toma tua conta, e escreve oitenta.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπῄνεσεν ὁ κύριος τὸν οἰκονόμον τῆς ἀδικίας ὅτι φρονίμως ἐποίησεν· ὅτι οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου φρονιμώτεροι ὑπὲρ τοὺς υἱοὺς τοῦ φωτὸς εἰς τὴν γενεὰν τὴν ἑαυτῶν εἰσιν.

controles.web: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.
controles.kjv: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
controles.livre: E aquele senhor elogiou o injusto mordomo, por ter feito prudentemente; porque os filhos deste mundo são mais prudentes do que os filhos da luz com esta geração.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγὼ ὑμῖν λέγω, ἑαυτοῖς ποιήσατε φίλους ἐκ τοῦ μαμωνᾶ τῆς ἀδικίας, ἵνα ὅταν ἐκλίπῃ δέξωνται ὑμᾶς εἰς τὰς αἰωνίους σκηνάς.

controles.web: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.
controles.kjv: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
controles.livre: E eu vos digo: fazei amigos para vós com as riquezas da injustiça, para que quando vos faltar, vos recebam nos tabernáculos eternos.

versos.grego: ὁ πιστὸς ἐν ἐλαχίστῳ καὶ ἐν πολλῷ πιστός ἐστιν, καὶ ὁ ἐν ἐλαχίστῳ ἄδικος καὶ ἐν πολλῷ ἄδικός ἐστιν.

controles.web: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
controles.kjv: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
controles.livre: Quem é fiel no mínimo, também é fiel no muito; e quem é injusto no mínimo, também é injusto no muito.

versos.grego: εἰ οὖν ἐν τῷ ἀδίκῳ μαμωνᾷ πιστοὶ οὐκ ἐγένεσθε, τὸ ἀληθινὸν τίς ὑμῖν πιστεύσει;

controles.web: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
controles.kjv: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
controles.livre: Pois se nas riquezas da injustiça não fostes fiéis, quem vos confiará as verdadeiras riquezas ?

versos.grego: καὶ εἰ ἐν τῷ ἀλλοτρίῳ πιστοὶ οὐκ ἐγένεσθε, τὸ ἡμέτερον τίς δώσει ὑμῖν;

controles.web: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
controles.kjv: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man’s, who shall give you that which is your own?
controles.livre: E se nas coisas dos outros não fostes fiéis, quem vos dará o que é vosso?

versos.grego: Οὐδεὶς οἰκέτης δύναται δυσὶ κυρίοις δουλεύειν· ἢ γὰρ τὸν ἕνα μισήσει καὶ τὸν ἕτερον ἀγαπήσει, ἢ ἑνὸς ἀνθέξεται καὶ τοῦ ἑτέρου καταφρονήσει. οὐ δύνασθε Θεῷ δουλεύειν καὶ μαμωνᾷ.

controles.web: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”
controles.kjv: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
controles.livre: Nenhum servo pode servir a dois senhores; porque ou irá odiar a um, e a amar ao outro; ou irá se achegar a um, e desprezar ao outro. Não podeis servir a Deus e às riquezas.

versos.grego: Ἤκουον δὲ ταῦτα πάντα οἱ Φαρισαῖοι φιλάργυροι ὑπάρχοντες, καὶ ἐξεμυκτήριζον αὐτόν.

controles.web: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
controles.kjv: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
controles.livre: E os fariseus também ouviram todas estas coisas, eles que eram avarentos. E zombaram dele.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὑμεῖς ἐστε οἱ δικαιοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὁ δὲ Θεὸς γινώσκει τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν· ὅτι τὸ ἐν ἀνθρώποις ὑψηλὸν βδέλυγμα ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Vós sois os que justificais a vós mesmos diante dos seres humanos; mas Deus conhece vossos corações. Porque o que é excelente para os seres humanos é odiável diante de Deus.

versos.grego: Ὁ νόμος καὶ οἱ προφῆται μέχρι Ἰωάνου· ἀπὸ τότε ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ εὐαγγελίζεται καὶ πᾶς εἰς αὐτὴν βιάζεται.

controles.web: The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of the Kingdom of God is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
controles.kjv: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
controles.livre: A Lei e os profetas foram até João; desde então, o Reino de Deus é anunciado, todo homem tenta entrar nele pela força.

versos.grego: εὐκοπώτερον δέ ἐστιν τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν παρελθεῖν ἢ τοῦ νόμου μίαν κεραίαν πεσεῖν.

controles.web: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.
controles.kjv: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
controles.livre: E é mais fácil passar o céu e a terra do que cair um traço de alguma letra da Lei.

versos.grego: Πᾶς ὁ ἀπολύων τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ γαμῶν ἑτέραν μοιχεύει, καὶ ὁ ἀπολελυμένην ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς γαμῶν μοιχεύει.

controles.web: Everyone who divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
controles.kjv: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
controles.livre: Qualquer que deixa sua mulher, e casa com outra, adultera; e qualquer que se casa com a deixada pelo marido, também adultera.

versos.grego: Ἄνθρωπος δέ τις ἦν πλούσιος, καὶ ἐνεδιδύσκετο πορφύραν καὶ βύσσον εὐφραινόμενος καθ’ ἡμέραν λαμπρῶς.

controles.web: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
controles.kjv: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
controles.livre: Havia porém um certo homem rico, e vestia-se de púrpura, e de linho finíssimo, e festejava todo dia com luxo.

versos.grego: πτωχὸς δέ τις ὀνόματι Λάζαρος ἐβέβλητο πρὸς τὸν πυλῶνα αὐτοῦ εἱλκωμένος

controles.web: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was laid at his gate, full of sores,
controles.kjv: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
controles.livre: Havia também um certo mendigo, de nome Lázaro, o qual ficava deitado à sua porta cheio de feridas.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπιθυμῶν χορτασθῆναι ἀπὸ τῶν πιπτόντων ἀπὸ τῆς τραπέζης τοῦ πλουσίου· ἀλλὰ καὶ οἱ κύνες ἐρχόμενοι ἐπέλειχον τὰ ἕλκη αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
controles.kjv: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man’s table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
controles.livre: E desejava se satisfazer com as migalhas que caíam da mesa do rico; porém vinham também os cães, e lambiam suas feridas.

versos.grego: ἐγένετο δὲ ἀποθανεῖν τὸν πτωχὸν καὶ ἀπενεχθῆναι αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀγγέλων εἰς τὸν κόλπον Ἀβραάμ· ἀπέθανεν δὲ καὶ ὁ πλούσιος καὶ ἐτάφη.

controles.web: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died, and was buried.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham’s bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
controles.livre: E aconteceu que o mendigo morreu, e foi levado pelos anjos para o colo de Abraão. E o rico também morreu, e foi sepultado.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν τῷ Ἅιδῃ ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ, ὑπάρχων ἐν βασάνοις, ὁρᾷ Ἀβραὰμ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν καὶ Λάζαρον ἐν τοῖς κόλποις αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
controles.kjv: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
controles.livre: E estando no mundo dos mortos em tormentos, ele levantou seus olhos, e viu a Abraão de longe, e a Lázaro em seu colo.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸς φωνήσας εἶπεν Πάτερ Ἀβραάμ, ἐλέησόν με καὶ πέμψον Λάζαρον ἵνα βάψῃ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ δακτύλου αὐτοῦ ὕδατος καὶ καταψύξῃ τὴν γλῶσσάν μου, ὅτι ὀδυνῶμαι ἐν τῇ φλογὶ ταύτῃ.

controles.web: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’
controles.kjv: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
controles.livre: E ele, chamando, disse: Pai Abraão, tem misericórdia de mim, e manda a Lázaro que molhe a ponta de seu dedo na água, e refresque a minha língua; porque estou sofrendo neste fogo.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ Ἀβραάμ Τέκνον, μνήσθητι ὅτι ἀπέλαβες τὰ ἀγαθά σου ἐν τῇ ζωῇ σου, καὶ Λάζαρος ὁμοίως τὰ κακά· νῦν δὲ ὧδε παρακαλεῖται σὺ δὲ ὀδυνᾶσαι.

controles.web: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But now here he is comforted and you are in anguish.
controles.kjv: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
controles.livre: Porém Abraão disse: Filho, lembra-te que em tua vida recebeste teus bens, e Lázaro do mesmo jeito recebeu males. E agora este é consolado, e tu és atormentado.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τούτοις μεταξὺ ἡμῶν καὶ ὑμῶν χάσμα μέγα ἐστήρικται, ὅπως οἱ θέλοντες διαβῆναι ἔνθεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς μὴ δύνωνται, μηδὲ ἐκεῖθεν πρὸς ἡμᾶς διαπερῶσιν.

controles.web: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’
controles.kjv: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
controles.livre: E, além de tudo isto, um grande abismo está posto entre nós e vós, para os que quisessem passar daqui para vós não possam; nem também os daí passarem para cá.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δέ Ἐρωτῶ σε οὖν, πάτερ, ἵνα πέμψῃς αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου·

controles.web: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house;
controles.kjv: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father’s house:
controles.livre: E disse ele: Rogo-te, pois, ó pai, que o mandes à casa de meu pai.

versos.grego: ἔχω γὰρ πέντε ἀδελφούς· ὅπως διαμαρτύρηται αὐτοῖς, ἵνα μὴ καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλθωσιν εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον τῆς βασάνου.

controles.web: for I have five brothers, that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
controles.kjv: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
controles.livre: Porque tenho cinco irmãos, para que lhes dê testemunho; para que também não venham para este lugar de tormento.

versos.grego: λέγει δὲ Ἀβραάμ Ἔχουσι Μωϋσέα καὶ τοὺς προφήτας· ἀκουσάτωσαν αὐτῶν.

controles.web: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
controles.kjv: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Abraão: Eles têm a Moisés e aos profetas, ouçam-lhes.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Οὐχί, πάτερ Ἀβραάμ, ἀλλ’ ἐάν τις ἀπὸ νεκρῶν πορευθῇ πρὸς αὐτοὺς, μετανοήσουσιν.

controles.web: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
controles.kjv: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
controles.livre: E ele disse: Não, pai Abraão; mas se alguém dos mortos fosse até eles, eles se arrependeriam.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Εἰ Μωϋσέως καὶ τῶν προφητῶν οὐκ ἀκούουσιν, οὐδὲ ἐάν τις ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῇ πεισθήσονται.

controles.web: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”
controles.kjv: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
controles.livre: Porém Abraão lhe disse: Se não ouvem a Moisés e aos profetas, também não se deixariam convencer, ainda que alguém ressuscite dos mortos.
